title: Toddler Boy in Overalls in Backyard, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white outdoor snapshot of a young toddler identified on the back as Dennis Phelps at 1 1/2 years old. He is dressed in light-colored bib overalls over a collared shirt and walking forward through a sunny backyard while holding a stick or small tool. In the background stands a thick palm tree trunk and a single-story clapboard house with clothesline wire strung across the yard, reflecting everyday postwar American family life.
